PATCH PUBLISHED  / PUBLISHED      / -                        -> 409
PATCH REVOKED    / PUBLISHED      / -                        -> 200, REVOKED

name: Webhook delivery of SchemaPublished and SchemaRevoked
description: SIMPL-19992 names the two event types; triggers, payload and delivery are
fixed by D42 to D44. The receiver runs inside the suite; the service reaches
it at WEBHOOK_RECEIVER_URL. Waits: 10 s for a delivery, 3 s for an absence.

elements.name: Creating a published RESOURCE schema delivers SchemaPublished

steps.name: the webhook "hook" is subscribed to "SchemaPublished,SchemaRevoked"
I am "ga-admin"
I create the RESOURCE schema "$A" for resource type "$RT"
the response status is 201
the webhook "hook" receives a "SchemaPublished" event for schema "$A"
the event was posted as JSON with the header "X-Simpl-Event" set to "SchemaPublished"
the event field "eventId" is a UUID
the event field "eventType" is "SchemaPublished"
the event field "occurredAt" is an ISO timestamp
the event field "schemaName" is "$A"
the event field "schemaType" is "RESOURCE"
the event field "resourceType" is "$RT"
the event field "version" is "1"
the event field "status" is "PUBLISHED"
the event field "schemaUri" is an absolute URI containing "/schemas/$A/1"
